message.content:
**Frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) in European populations**

| Source | Population | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|--------|------------|------------------------------|
| **gnomAD v2.1.1** (Exome + Genome) | Non-Finnish European (NFE) | **≈ 0.07 – 0.08** (7 – 8 %) |
| **1000 Genomes Project** (Phase 3) | European (EUR) | **≈ 0.07** (7 %) |
| **UK Biobank** (European ancestry) | UK Europeans | **≈ 0.07** (7 %) |

> **Interpretation**  
> The rs7412 C allele corresponds to the APOE ε2 variant. In most European cohorts it is present in roughly 7 % of chromosomes, which translates to about 13 % of individuals being heterozygous (ε2/ε3) and ~0.5 % being homozygous (ε2/ε2). Frequencies can vary slightly between sub‑populations (e.g., higher in Southern Europeans, lower in Northern Europeans), but the overall range remains close to 6–9 %.

### Quick reference

- **gnomAD**: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/
- **1000 Genomes**: https://www.internationalgenome.org/
- **APOE allele definitions**: ε2 (rs7412 C), ε3 (rs429358 T + rs7412 T), ε4 (rs429358 C + rs7412 T)

If you need the exact allele count or a more granular breakdown (e.g., by country or ancestry group), let me know and I can pull the latest numbers from the respective databases.
